config.script:
# kanoaTablet's asset navigation: the panel Asset Operation uses (868mwap0a). A line selected when the page opens (on
	# the way back from its Asset Operation page) shows its parent's assets, as before
	storedAssetPath = system.kanoa.utilities.getStoredAssetPath(self)
	assetType = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetTypeName', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': storedAssetPath}))
	if assetType == 'line':
		parentPath = '\\'.join(storedAssetPath.split('\\')[:-1])
		system.kanoa.utilities.storeAssetPath(self, parentPath)
	self.custom.currentAssetPath = system.kanoa.utilities.getStoredAssetPath(self)
	return
